  1. Dry season (May to October)

  1. Research and plan ahead
  2. Work with a reputable guide or tour operator
  3. Pack the right gear

  2. Choose more efficient airlines
  3. Fly economy
  4. Consider alternative modes of transportation
  5. Choose eco-friendly hotels
  6. Opt for apartments or hostels
  7. Stay in locally owned accommodations
  8. Pack light

  11. Eat locally sourced food
  12. Turn off lights and electronics
  13. Support local conservation efforts
- [EVENT] User is thinking of capturing night sky photos while in Africa.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended camera settings and techniques for night sky photography include:
  1. Manual Mode
  2. Low ISO (100-400)
  3. Wide Aperture (f/2.8 or lower)
  4. Long Exposure (20-30 seconds or more)
  5. White Balance set to "Daylight" or "Cloudy"
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested techniques for night sky photography include:
  1. Use a Tripod
  2. Focus on Infinity
  3. Use the Live View
  4. Shoot in RAW
  5. Bracket Your Shots
